features.rationale: The description lists a PRE PARTY on Thursday 13th May before the main festival.
The description has an AFTER PARTY section on Monday 17th.
The event is described as all in one resort, with the festival held at Hotel Orquidea and a hotel promo for the event.
The festival lineup includes eight workshops.
A live concert with a band is part of the event.
A hotel promo code is offered for booking the event hotels, without the accommodation being included in the pass.
